exposure: non-dipping pattern of blood pressure in gestational hypertension (GH)
outcome: prevalence of hypertension later in life
reduced absolute values of left ventricular global longitudinal strain (LVGLS)
cohort: The study included 138 pregnant women with gestational hypertension (67 non-dippers, 71 dippers), 55 with preeclampsia, and 72 normotensive pregnant controls.
finding: The non-dipping blood pressure pattern in gestational hypertension was significantly associated with the onset of hypertension later in life and with decreased systolic function.
